items.title: EU leaders reportedly fail to agree on new Ukraine loan
items.summary: EU leaders reportedly ended their Brussels summit without agreement on a proposed €45 billion loan for Ukraine or the bloc's next seven-year budget. Further budget negotiations are expected in December.

items.title: Former US deputy secretary of state Strobe Talbott reportedly dies
items.summary: Former US deputy secretary of state Strobe Talbott, who advised President Bill Clinton on relations with Russia and other former Soviet states, has reportedly died at age 80.

items.title: Russia and China hold strategic defence consultations
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov participated in the first round of strategic consultations between the Russian and Chinese defence departments.
